request.spec: When I open a client show me the projects I am doing for them.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
When I open a client show me the projects I am doing for them.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Here's what I implemented for **"When I open a client show me the projects I am doing for them"**:

## Change summary

The feature is a cross-feature reuse, exactly as the spec framed it — the DB schema (`projects.client_id`, Flyway V3) and server endpoint (`GET /api/projects`, which already serves each project with its `clientId`) already carry everything the request needs, so no migration or new server code was required. The change is four additive front-end files/edits:

1. **`routes/clients.tsx`** (new) — one-line layout route (`<Outlet />`) so Clients can have detail children, mirroring `routes/projects.tsx` (CLAUDE.md rule 1).

2. **`routes/clients.$clientId.tsx`** (new) — the drill-in child route (`data-testid="client-detail-page"`), rendering the client's projects (rule 2 — a route, not a flag).

3. **`features/clients/ClientProjects.tsx`** (new) — reads the **shared `['projects']` query key** (queryFn `/api/projects`) and filters to the open client's `clientId`, then renders them in a `client-projects-table`, reusing the `project-row-<id>` / `project-name` anchors. It shares the key rather than importing the projects feature (rule 5 — same precedent as `useClientOptions` reusing `['clients']`), so creating a project anywhere refreshes this list automatically.

4. **`features/clients/ClientList.tsx`** (edit) — added an "Open" link column (`client-open-<id>` → `/clients/$clientId`), mirroring the existing `project-open-<id>` column in `ProjectList`.

Verification: `npm run typecheck` passes, and `bin/e2e` passes the acceptance test — the open client shows only its own two projects (Website Rebuild, Mobile App), and Globex's Intranet is correctly excluded.
